{{/* gd-docs-theme-next: the version list, for the selector, the banner and the archive table. Returns site.Params.versions when the environment sets it (production: the release bot keeps config/public/params.toml current). Otherwise (dev server, PR previews) it reads params.versionsSource.file, the same list, so there is no second copy to go stale. Relative urls become links on the live site (params.versionsSource.liveURL), since those builds carry no versioned content, and params.versionsSource.local heads the list as the version being built. The file is read with os.ReadFile, which hugo server does not watch: restart it to pick up a new release. */}} {{- $versions := site.Params.versions -}} {{- $src := site.Params.versionsSource -}} {{- if and (not $versions) $src $src.file -}} {{- if fileExists $src.file -}} {{- $versions = slice -}} {{- with $src.local }}{{ $versions = $versions | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- $live := strings.TrimSuffix "/" ($src.liveURL | default "") -}} {{- /* Wrapped as a .toml resource: on a plain string Unmarshal guesses the format and reads TOML as YAML. */ -}} {{- range (resources.FromString "versions-source.toml" (os.ReadFile $src.file) | transform.Unmarshal).versions -}} {{- $v := . -}} {{- if and $live (hasPrefix (.url | default "") "/") -}}{{ $v = merge . (dict "url" (print $live .url)) }}{{- end -}} {{- $versions = $versions | append $v -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- warnf "versions: params.versionsSource.file %q not found; the version list is empty" $src.file -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($versions | default slice) -}}
